headline: Guard note for types.ts modifications
what_breaks: packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx — relies on Collaborator and App types
why: This file defines critical types used across multiple components and actions. Changes to these types can lead to widespread issues in dependent files and components.
checklist: Review changes to Collaborator and ClipboardData types for impact.
Ensure any modifications to types don't break existing imports in App.tsx.
Check compatibility of changes with Action type in actions/types.ts.
Confirm that new types or changes are reflected in related components.
